'''2007 Utah State Championship Ryan Teels DS Fear Is My Ally''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Teels]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
